system:
You write the final report of a trial-autopsy system for an analyst. Plain language, precise,
no hype. Use only the provided material; every number must appear in it. When you name the source of a number,
use the source title given for that fact_id in the Facts list. State uncertainty honestly.

Return JSON only:
{"headline": "<one sentence verdict>",
 "summary": "<3-5 sentences: what happened or is expected, why, how sure>",
 "key_evidence": ["<short bullet with the number and its source title>", "..."],
 "what_would_change_this": "<one or two sentences>",
 "readthrough_note": "<one or two sentences on other programmes, or empty>"}

response: {"headline": "The OCEAN(a) outcomes trial of olpasiran cannot be forecast because the trial has not yet read out; event count and on-treatment Lp(a) reduction at the phase 3 dose are unknown.", "summary": "The phase 3 OCEAN(a) trial randomized 7,297 patients with established ASCVD and Lp(a) ≥200 nmol/L to olpasiran or placebo, with a primary endpoint of time to CHD death, myocardial infarction, or urgent coronary revascularization over a median 5-year follow-up (ClinicalTrials.gov NCT05581303). Phase 2 data show deep but waning Lp(a) reduction: -97.4% at week 36 (75 mg Q12W) declining to -27.9% at 96 weeks off treatment (Small Interfering RNA to Reduce Lipoprotein(a) in Cardiovascular Disease; The Off-Treatment Effects of Olpasiran on Lipoprotein(a) Lowering: OCEAN(a)-DOSE Extension Period Results). The calculator projects HR 0.772 (22.8% RRR) using the week-36 nadir, requiring 470 events for 80% power, but the sustained effect over 5 years may be far lower. Human genetics strongly support Lp(a) causality (LPA score 0.922, Mendelian randomization ORs 1.38–3.67 per allele) (opentargets:LPA; Genetic variants associated with Lp(a) lipoprotein level and coronary disease). Confidence is medium because the forecast hinges on missing data rather than a demonstrated small effect.", "key_evidence": ["7,297 participants randomized (ClinicalTrials.gov NCT05581303)", "Inclusion threshold: Lp(a) ≥200 nmol/L (ClinicalTrials.gov NCT05581303)", "Primary endpoint: time to CHD death, MI, or urgent coronary revascularization; median follow-up 5 years (ClinicalTrials.gov NCT05581303)", "Phase 2 Lp(a) reduction: -97.4% at week 36 (75 mg Q12W), waning to -27.9% at 96 weeks (Small Interfering RNA to Reduce Lipoprotein(a) in Cardiovascular Disease; The Off-Treatment Effects of Olpasiran on Lipoprotein(a) Lowering: OCEAN(a)-DOSE Extension Period Results)", "Phase 2 baseline median Lp(a): 260.3 nmol/L (Small Interfering RNA to Reduce Lipoprotein(a) in Cardiovascular Disease; Olpasiran, Oxidized Phospholipids, and Systemic Inflammatory Biomarkers: Results From the OCEAN(a)-DOSE Trial)", "Genetic evidence: LPA association score 0.922; MR ORs 1.38–3.67 for coronary disease (opentargets:LPA; Genetic variants associated with Lp(a) lipoprotein level and coronary disease)", "Calculator projection: expected HR 0.772 (22.8% RRR); 470 events needed for 80% power (calculator)"], "what_would_change_this": "Phase 3 readout with observed HR, confidence interval, total events, and on-treatment Lp(a) reduction trajectory at the actual dose used.", "readthrough_note": "Other Lp(a)-lowering programs in phase 3 include pelacarsen (antisense, HORIZON trial) and lepodisiran (siRNA, Lp(a)HORIZON); their readouts will inform whether sustained Lp(a) reduction translates to cardiovascular benefit in secondary prevention."}
